audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Abigail’s graveyard sword-practice scene and Shane’s Joja Bluu advertisement shoot. Every spoken line, player response, sword and cave term, family conflict, filmmaking instruction, fictional product claim, comic performance, and character voice was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, forks and response IDs, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Town records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
